likeness_qualification: Several public portrait references are later or undated. These are stylised likenesses, not exact documented 2016 appearances. Original photographs are not reproduced.
photo_rights_note: Reference use does not establish a licence to reproduce the original photographs. No source photographs or contact sheets are included in this release.
interpretation: Six stylised likenesses gather around an imagined altar, while the historical participants worked in geographically separate locations. Six crystals and connecting light symbolise the private contributions and shared public result. The altar, floating coin, crystals, gathering and jar are invented staging. The detached CPU-like board is a generic symbolic radio-removal/air-gap cue, not an exact Wi-Fi card. The jar combines Todd’s 24 October hardware-destruction phase with the 22–23 October computation. No physical coin was summoned and no cross-card cameo is claimed.
security_qualification: ONE HONEST WITNESS is an approved editorial paraphrase, not a quotation. Under the protocol’s assumptions, one honest, uncompromised participant securely destroying their private contribution was sufficient to prevent reconstruction of the combined secret. This does not remove every trust assumption or exclude software and cryptographic flaws.
